notes: The existing and queued lists already cover Vieuxtemps's published violin output: all seven concertos, Opp. 16 and 48 études, the salon sets (Opp. 7, 8, 22, 32, 34, 40, 45, 53, 54, 55), the opera fantasies and the American pieces. I could not name any further violin work with enough certainty about its opus number and edition to add it. Several other works were deliberately left out because they fall outside scope: the viola works (Sonata Op. 36, Capriccio 'Hommage à Paganini', Élégie viola version), the cello concertos and the string quartets. Some opus numbers in the queued list (for example Op. 29 used for both Andante et Rondo and the Verdi fantasies, and Op. 33 for both Bouquet américain and the Lucia fantasy) should be checked against IMSLP before import.
